projects.title: CAIS Terminal
projects.description: An interactive terminal in the browser for exploring CAIS: learning resources, community links, upcoming events, the team, and a few easter eggs. Type 'help' to get started.

projects.title: CuMind
projects.description: A MuZero-style reinforcement learning framework built with JAX and Flax, combining a learned model with Monte Carlo Tree Search for complex decision-making environments.

projects.title: The Carleton AI Show
projects.description: The club's interview podcast about AI, with guests from industry and academia: Nayeem Ekbal of ReveMax, Dr. Matthew Holden, Dr. Jacob Levman and Dr. Tracey P. Lauriault.

projects.title: CAIS Workshop Code
projects.description: The code behind CAIS workshops by Workshop Lead Farzad Roozitalab: GPT-2 text generation, BERT sentiment analysis, GANs, U-Net segmentation, attention mechanisms and more.

projects.title: Digit Recognition
projects.description: A multi-session club project that trained a model on the MNIST handwritten-digit dataset, aiming to serve it on a web page where you draw a digit for it to read.

projects.title: Rock-Paper-Scissors AI
projects.description: The club-wide project for Fall 2019, built by 17 members: a Python AI designed to beat real human players at Rock, Paper, Scissors.

projects.title: ThinkFirst
projects.description: An AI tutor that helps students understand concepts instead of handing them the answers.

projects.title: CUCognitive
projects.description: A web app that tracks drowsiness through eye movement to help students study and manage their energy.

projects.title: Procrastination Bot
projects.description: An AI agent that uses retrieval-augmented generation to track deadlines and break assignments into manageable tasks.

projects.title: ChatRoller
projects.description: Real-time sentiment analysis for YouTube livestream chat, by Ryan Diep and Mika Toktamyssov, built with Node.js, the Cohere API and the YouTube Data API.

projects.title: WLIT: What Language Is This?
projects.description: A machine learning language detector that identifies 11 languages, by Ryan Guo, Sahith Nulu, Roshan Dewmina Silva and Ethan Huynh.
